sources.label: Branding Questionnaire (recommended)
sources.detail: Agent asks one-by-one, or send as a written questionnaire. Load intake/skills/README.md, then intake/skills/questionnaire/SKILL.md (questions: intake/brand-intake-questionnaire.md).
sources.prompt: This brand-guide kit is still a starter (intake pending). Load intake/skills/README.md, then intake/skills/questionnaire/SKILL.md: ask one question at a time from intake/brand-intake-questionnaire.md, save answers to resources/transcripts/, set brand/setup.json intake to "complete", then rewrite brand.md (including Design system), examples.md, rules.md, and brand/setup.json from the transcript. Follow intake/skills/_shared.md. Run npm run compile from guide/. When done, set brand/setup.json status to "populated". Do not hand-edit brand.json or tokens.json.

sources.label: Website URL
sources.detail: Marketing site, product page, or About page. Load intake/skills/website/SKILL.md. Skips the questionnaire.
sources.prompt:
Populate this brand-guide kit from my website. Set brand/setup.json intake to "skipped". Load intake/skills/README.md, then intake/skills/website/SKILL.md (shared contract: intake/skills/_shared.md): read the URL I provide (marketing / product / About), inventory before write, then update brand.md (Strategy / Voice / Visual / Expressions / Design system), examples.md, rules.md, and brand/setup.json — cite the URL in sources[] with kind "citation". Run npm run compile from guide/. Keep the guide section structure; keep grayscale unless the site specifies a palette. When done, set status to "populated". Do not hand-edit brand.json or tokens.json.

Website URL:

sources.label: brand.md
sources.detail: A brand constitution file. Load intake/skills/brand-md/SKILL.md. Skips the questionnaire.
sources.prompt:
Populate this brand-guide kit from an existing brand.md (or compatible constitution). Set brand/setup.json intake to "skipped". Load intake/skills/README.md, then intake/skills/brand-md/SKILL.md (shared contract: intake/skills/_shared.md): merge or replace this repo’s brand.md with my source (Strategy / Voice / Visual / Expressions / Design system), update examples.md, rules.md, and brand/setup.json as needed, and cite the source in sources[] with kind "citation". Run npm run compile from guide/. When done, set status to "populated". Do not hand-edit brand.json or tokens.json.

Source brand.md path or paste:

sources.label: Design dump / DESIGN.md
sources.detail: Stitch/MD3-style DESIGN.md with YAML colors/type/radius/spacing. Load intake/skills/design-dump/SKILL.md (npm run import:design). Skips the questionnaire.
sources.prompt:
Populate this brand-guide kit from a design dump (DESIGN.md). Set brand/setup.json intake to "skipped". Load intake/skills/README.md, then intake/skills/design-dump/SKILL.md (shared contract: intake/skills/_shared.md): from guide/, run npm run import:design -- --print <path> (or --splice --yes to replace the Design system fence), then fill Strategy / Voice / Visual / Expressions from any prose in the dump without inventing pillars from token names. Write brand/coverage.json. Cite the dump in sources[] with kind "citation". Run npm run compile and npm run post-populate-check from guide/. When done, set status to "populated". Do not hand-edit brand.json or tokens.json.

DESIGN.md path:
